units.source_text: 他们一来到西边回廊的入口处，映入眼帘的便是红色垂樱，

en.t: As soon as they reached the entrance to the western corridor, red weeping cherry blossoms came into view,

units.source_text: 马上使人感觉到春天的景色。

en.t: at once giving them the feeling of a springtime scene.

units.source_text: 连低垂的细长枝梢上，都成簇成簇地开满了红色八重樱。

en.t: Even the drooping, slender tips of the branches were covered in clusters of red double cherry blossoms.

units.source_text: 像这样的花丛，与其说是花儿开在树上，

en.t: With blossoms massed like this, it was less that the flowers were blooming on the tree,

units.source_text: 不如说是花儿铺满了枝头。

en.t: than that they had spread all over the branches.
